scope: Private navigation fixture consumer only; source/static and portable models, no PowerShell/.NET/UIA/native execution

content.scope: private example only; observation without layout, focus, input or accessibility mutation

path.directory: Exact owned packaged application's ApplicationData.Current.LocalFolder; resolve using existing AppUserModelId/Resolve-NativeDragTracePath path, no arbitrary path request
path.prefix: nyctron-navigation-probe-<decimal PID>-<decimal process creation FILETIME UTC>
path.write: CreateNew temporary final+'.tmp'; complete bytes+flush+close then non-replacing atomic move to final; immutable per sequence; reject existing destination

message.name: NYCTron.Example.NavigationProbe.v1
message.send: PostMessageW to exact owned live HWND

header.session: fresh CoCreateGuid B-format string ({...}), exact match ready; driver validates GUID and liveness/creation
header.creationFileTime: decimal string equal current owned process.StartTime.ToFileTimeUtc()
header.windowHandle: decimal signed Int64 string equal exact owned HWND

ready.threadId: actual native UI thread ID integer
ready.messageId: RegisterWindowMessageW result, driver must independently compute same

request.generation: 0 for phase1; exact returned generation for phase2; not threadId/complete required

response.failure: fixed enum for unavailable; no arbitrary exception text

snapshot.stable: boolean of two equal sequential reads

content.binding: Native exact weak registry ticket, component tag/current ChildSiteLink, identical root/island/nav/toggle/icon checked on UI dispatcher. Role numbers are local to generation, not pointers. Phase1 binds once; phase2 must preserve binding. Consumer binds independent owner HWND/PID/runtime ID and sequential owner physical rectangle; UIA owner and native converted roles must be contained rather than assumed identical decoration bounds.
consumerRequirements: Preserve existing native actions, strict LTR-left to RTL-right half check, stable same owner/navigation/toggle identity and size, physical-left pane, selection/capture/later drawer/high contrast, original error/cleanup.
Preserve existing 10-second/100ms RTL retry window; do not reset deadline for each native response. Synchronous provider calls cannot be canceled by the poll deadline.

Accept only complete bounded fresh response after own exact request+PostMessage; match all headers, schema, sourceRevision/session/current process creation/window/thread, seq/phase and generation; fail on missing/ambiguous/malformed/stale/truncated/unavailable.

Read fixed immutable complete files, reject reparse/partial/oversize inputs; retain exact response bytes/hash in output and bounded query-free typed console summary. Never copy arbitrary provider text/tree/path/error to console.
Readiness and per-request IO must not introduce focus/input/provider reacquisition fallback; absent registry/peer/conversion must fail explicitly.
No assumption that UIA Icon peer exists: this native hook traverses actual template visuals using public VisualTreeHelper and converters.

dependencies.relationship: Calls the child in its existing scope after four strict drag scenarios; retains process.Handle, ownedProcessId, ownedProcessStartTime, AppUserModelId and NativeWindow methods. No parent edit.

Existing Resolve-NativeDragTracePath validates AppUserModelId, resolves one PackageFamilyName and derives the exact LocalState directory. The new consumer discards only the old drag filename and forms the fixed PID/creation probe prefix.
Separate native source review; observation-only fixed protocol. Native execution remains unverified.

actionStatements: Find-ByName $Window "Settings opened without changing the committed route." | Out-Null

laterTail.normalization: Only Write-NativeRtlWitnessSummary is mapped to the original Write-RawRtlWitnessSummary call for comparison; every other later action/assertion/catch/finally/restoration/result byte is identical.

preserved.readContrast: Borrowed SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST scheme copy is unchanged; owned SET StringToHGlobalUni/FreeHGlobal remains unchanged.
preserved.rtlDeadline: Same one (Get-Date).AddSeconds(10) deadline and 100 ms outer sleep. Every phase-2 response/final snapshot receives this same deadline; no refresh or retry of a request sequence.
preserved.physicalPane: Original physical-left pane midpoint, selection, screenshot, collapse, contrast and restoration assertions remain strict.

newObservation.initial: Ready file must already exist; one phase-1 request uses its own bounded 10 s initial response window and binds one native generation.
newObservation.paths: Fixed exact packaged LocalState prefix and fixed OutDir capture names. No response path is accepted from JSON.
newObservation.fileRead: CreateFileW OPEN_EXISTING/FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, disk/non-directory/non-reparse, FILE_SHARE_READ without write/delete sharing, exact final path, bounded complete stable read before UTF-8 decoding/hash. Retained exclusive copies are read back and compared.
newObservation.fileWrite: CREATE_NEW temporary name, complete write/Flush(true)/close, non-replacing File.Move; native never opens .tmp. Retention is CREATE_NEW and never overwrites prior evidence.
newObservation.json: Fixed object-only protocol grammar rejects duplicate or case-aliased keys, unsupported strings/arrays and invalid numeric syntax before ConvertFrom-Json. Typed schema then rejects unknown, missing, extra or mismatched fields.
newObservation.freshness: Held process handle PID/creation and parent initial UTC start time, owner native HWND/thread/process/runtime ID, source revision, session GUID, exact sequence/phase and native generation. No process search, provider reacquisition, UIA Icon assumption or input/layout mutation.
newObservation.bounds: Strict Int32 physical rectangles with checked edges, owned-container containment, two sequential native observations plus bracketed owner rectangle; exact old half-side predicate retained.
newObservation.failure: Missing/malformed/unavailable/stale/partial/ambiguous/unretained observations fail. Native failure in typed state is a fixed enum or null; original raw bytes remain separate. Original outer error/restoration behavior is preserved.
newObservation.limits: Retry deadlines do not cancel synchronous UIA or file calls; sequential stability is neither atomic nor render-completion proof. No observed geometry or runtime success is claimed.

historicalCandidate.note: Superseded only to normalize two unavailable nativeFailure state assignments through the shared fixed-enum-or-null helper; no acceptance relaxation.

reviewChecks: Focused reproducible portable source/contract/IO/lifecycle/projection models follow separately. Real Windows PowerShell parsing, C# compilation, native compilation and UIA execution remain unexecuted here.
